sources.adaptation_description: Production minimal source reduction retains only the upstream symbols required by Cnn14_16k, ResNet38, and Wavegram_Logmel_Cnn14; adapts the pytorch_utils import to package-relative form; and exposes the existing fc_audioset result as raw logits before applying the unchanged sigmoid. The authoritative ordered AudioSet class metadata is copied unchanged.
sources.justification: The official repository is not packaged, the official inference package omits the requested classes, and the retained source dependency closure, license, and authoritative 527-class metadata form the minimal production substrate for all three accepted identities.
